description: 7 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers deriving a DTCG tokens.json source of truth from brand decisions and emitting CSS/Tailwind + deck templates, carries BOTH filenames as user utterances (the resolver reads tokens.json; a consumer who followed this package's own earlier wording types .tokens.json), and includes one German phrasing. Should-not covers near-miss neighbours — generic token authoring without a brand frame, defining rather than emitting identity, asset generation, validation — plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: turn our confirmed brand identity into design tokens
derive a tokens.json source of truth from the brand colours and type
derive a .tokens.json source of truth from the brand colours and type
queries.note: the dotted name this package once told consumers to write — kept as a user utterance; the resolver never reads it

queries.q: emit the brand as CSS variables and a Tailwind theme
export brand deck templates with the brand variables locked
generate the brand token system that pack-ai-image will consume
mach aus unserer Markenidentität echte Design-Tokens und gib sie als CSS-Variablen aus
author a generic 3-layer token system for this app (no brand)
queries.note: generic token authoring with no brand frame -> design-tokens

queries.note: defining the identity constraint set -> brand-identity
